title: Fix: longest words first

ticket.subject: Label order is backwards
ticket.body: The label list should show the longest word first, and words of the same length go A to Z. The current code puts the shortest word first.

rules: Words of the same length are ordered A to Z.

title: Fix: add up nested lists

ticket.subject: Totals miss nested lists
ticket.body: The total should add every number, including numbers inside nested lists. An empty list adds up to 0. The current code keeps only the last nested total.

rules: Add up every number, however deeply it is nested.
An empty list adds up to 0.

title: Structure: annotate two functions

ticket.subject: Hints for the report tool
ticket.body: The report tool reads the type hints. Add them to total_weight and label_for so the tool can read each parameter and each result.

rules: Annotate every parameter and the return value of each function.

title: Structure: serve the queue from the front

ticket.subject: Serve the queue in order
ticket.body: Serve every parcel from a deque, front first, and return the parcels in the order they were served.

rules: Take each item from the front with popleft(), and do not use pop(0).

title: Structure: three smallest with heapq

ticket.subject: Three lightest parcels
ticket.body: Return the three smallest weights. Use heapq.nsmallest, imported with from heapq import nsmallest, and do not sort the whole list.

rules: Use heapq.nsmallest, imported with from heapq import nsmallest, and do not call sorted().
